content.title: How to Sign a PDF on iPhone Free
content.meta_description: Sign PDF forms, add dates, checkmarks, and custom text on your iPhone for free using on-device tools or iOS Markup without monthly fees.
content.h1: How to Sign and Fill a PDF on iPhone for Free
content.quick_answer: You can sign a PDF on iPhone for free using Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit or built-in iOS Markup. Draw your signature using your finger or Apple Pencil, position it on the line, and add dates, text, or checkmarks. Processing runs on your device without subscription fees or forced cloud uploads.
intro: Your landlord just emailed a rental agreement that requires your signature and today's date before the end of the day. You are away from a printer and computer, holding only your iPhone.

Signing forms on a mobile screen does not require an expensive paid subscription or creating accounts on third-party websites. iOS includes built-in tools for basic markup, while dedicated on-device apps make it easy to complete full forms with dates, checkmarks, and saved reusable signatures.
This guide covers how to fill and sign PDF agreements directly on your iPhone for free, maintain privacy by keeping files local, and quickly email the completed document back.
content.steps_heading: How to Sign and Fill Forms with Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit

steps.title: Open the PDF document in the app
steps.detail: Import the PDF agreement from Mail, Files, or cloud storage into Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit. Verify that all pages display clearly before placing form fields.

steps.title: Draw and create your signature
steps.detail: Select the signature option to draw your signature using your finger or an Apple Pencil on iPad. You can save this signature for reuse across future forms, so you do not need to redraw it every time.

steps.title: Place and resize the signature on the page
steps.detail: Drag the drawn signature to the designated signature line. Adjust the bounding box so the signature fits neatly above the line without overlapping surrounding legal text.

steps.title: Add required text, dates, and checkmarks
steps.detail: Insert text boxes for your full name, printed details, and the current date. Tap to place checkmarks inside agreement boxes, ensuring each required field is answered.

steps.title: Save and export the signed document
steps.detail: Export your completed agreement as a PDF to Mail, Files, AirDrop, or your chosen cloud storage. If your email client flags the final attachment as too large, you can compress the file size using a separate workflow before sending.

content.alternatives_heading: Alternative Free Ways to Sign a PDF on iPhone

alternatives.method: Built-in iOS Markup in Files, Mail, or Photos
alternatives.how: Open the PDF in Files, Mail, or Photos, tap the Markup pen icon, tap the + button, and select Add Signature to draw and place your name.
alternatives.best_for: Quick one-time signatures when you only need to sign a single line without complex form-filling tools.
alternatives.limitation: Adding text fields, dates, and checkmarks can feel clunky in the native interface compared to dedicated PDF form tools.

alternatives.method: Free online web-based PDF signing tools
alternatives.how: Upload your PDF to an online browser tool via Safari, draw a signature on-screen, and download the finished file.
alternatives.best_for: Users working on unsupported operating systems who lack built-in PDF tools.
alternatives.limitation: Requires uploading your document to a third-party server, raising privacy risks for sensitive rental agreements and IDs, while free tiers often restrict daily use.

content.features_heading: Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit Features for Signing Forms

feature_points.benefit: Draw your signature once, save it for reuse, resize it to fit cramped signature boxes, and insert accompanying dates, text, and checkmarks directly onto forms.
All form filling and signature placement run entirely on your iPhone, keeping your sensitive lease terms, banking details, and personal records securely on your local storage.
Export signed PDF agreements directly back to Mail, AirDrop, Files, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or Dropbox without adding watermarks or export restrictions.

content.tips_heading: Tips for Clean and Accurate Mobile PDF Signing
tips: Rotate your iPhone to landscape mode when drawing your signature to give your finger more horizontal screen space.
Use text boxes instead of handwriting for dates and names to ensure legal agreements remain legible for the recipient.
Double-check every page for initials boxes before exporting so you do not have to reopen the document to sign omitted sections.
If you ever need to turn a signed contract into a Word file, note that editable .docx conversion requires a dedicated Pro workflow rather than standard PDF export.

faqs.question: Can I draw and save a reusable signature on iPhone for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit allows you to draw your signature using your finger or an Apple Pencil and save it for future reuse at no cost. You can place and resize that saved signature on any subsequent document.

faqs.question: How do I add dates, checkmarks, and custom text to a PDF form?
faqs.answer: Using the free sign and fill tools in the app, you can place text fields directly over form lines to type your name or the date. You can also insert checkmarks to fill checkboxes throughout multi-page forms.

faqs.question: How do I sign a PDF using the built-in iOS Markup tool?
faqs.answer: Open the PDF document in Files, Mail, or Photos and tap the Markup pen icon. Then tap the + button in the toolbar and select Add Signature to draw a signature and insert it on the page.

faqs.question: Can I use my finger or an Apple Pencil to sign forms?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can sketch your signature with your finger on any iPhone screen. If you are using an iPad, you can also use an Apple Pencil for finer line control.

faqs.question: Are signed documents kept safe on my device without cloud uploads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Document Scanner & PDF Toolkit processes signatures and edits locally on your device. Your documents are not uploaded to external servers and remain stored on your iPhone unless you manually choose an external cloud destination.

cta.heading: Sign and Return Your PDF Forms in Minutes
